picks.headline: Adobe's IBC release for Premiere and After Effects
picks.excerpt: Adobe's IBC 2026 release brings AI-generated video directly inside the Premiere Pro timeline, alongside new AI-assisted tools across After Effects. Scott Simmons breaks down what actually lands in the edit suite.
picks.rationale: Generative Media Tool ships in Premiere this week and an AE AI assistant writes expression rigs — the deepest hands-on breakdown in the pool.

picks.headline: DaVinci Resolve Gets AI Assistant Integration and Other New Features
picks.excerpt: Blackmagic Design has rolled out its latest update for DaVinci Resolve (version 21.1), introducing AI assistant integration and over 100 new tools and controls. Here’s what you need to know.
picks.rationale: Resolve 21.1 puts an AI assistant in the NLE and quietly moves Python scripting behind Studio — both change day-one workflows.

picks.headline: Origami Platform Updates Media Management, Audio Conform, Security and AI Capabilities
picks.excerpt: Cloud post-production platform Origami has released new capabilities spanning the full post workflow, from on-set media management to audio conform. The update adds AI capabilities aimed at cutting manual prep across the pipeline.
picks.rationale: Collections kills manual handoff reorganization and a native MCP endpoint lets an AI agent query pipeline metadata directly.

picks.headline: Pitch Black's Troy Tobin on where Rising Sun's REVIZE is now headed
picks.excerpt: Rising Sun Pictures' machine-learning face and performance tool REVIZE is expanding into new territory under Pitch Black. Troy Tobin explains where the ML tech is being pushed next in production.
picks.rationale: A proven in-house ML face tool leaves its home studio and lands at FOLKS, El Ranchito and Square One.

picks.headline: Indie VG 'Astro Burn' Starts New Level with AI-Powered Animated Micro-Series
picks.excerpt: 'Astro Burn's cuddly hero is embarking on new missions in an animated micro-series from Beyond the Pixels and AI animation co. Nura.
picks.rationale: A concrete cost/schedule datapoint: one episode per working week from a model locked to the creator's own assets, with human voice and music kept.
